exposure: non-occurrence of morbidity prior to gestation
cohort: The study included 430 pregnant women aged 35 years or older whose records were admitted between January and July 2012.
finding: Complications occurred in 77.7% of cases and were significantly associated with premature birth and C-section, while younger age, absence of prenatal care, and non-occurrence of prior morbidity were associated with complications in pregnancy.
mod_finding: Complications during pregnancy were significantly associated with C-section.
